_readme: HELD-OUT validation probe set for the arch-memory band calibration.
Plan: docs/plans/arch-memory-band-recalibration.md §7c.
WHY THIS EXISTS
The primary fixture (arch-memory-probes.json) was partially re-labelled
AFTER seeing a failing run. Measured attribution showed those post-hoc
edits contributed +0.238 recall and +0.0084 median — i.e. the primary set's
'pass' depends on acceptance criteria widened by the same person who failed
them. That is circular and cannot validate itself.
PROTOCOL — this set is only meaningful if the protocol holds:
1. Every intent and expected symbol below was written BEFORE running any
consultation against them. Symbols were chosen by reading names and
module paths from a schema listing, never from similarity results.
2. Expectations are LOCKED. If a probe misses, that is a recorded result,
NOT an invitation to add an alternate. Do not edit this file to make a
gate pass — that would destroy the only untainted measurement we have.
3. `alternates` appear only where a genuine ambiguity was foreseen a
priori (same-file siblings that plausibly answer the same intent).
4. If the codebase changes such that a probe is genuinely invalid (symbol
deleted/renamed), retire the probe explicitly with a dated note rather
than silently repointing it.
Authored 2026-07-20, against active snapshot 68f8af66 (3,478 symbols),
deliberately drawn from modules the primary fixture never touched:
install/, dashboard/, nav/, and the rmsync AST tooling.
SCORING NOTE: a miss here may reflect terse or off-target purposeSummary
text rather than a retrieval defect. Read the returned candidates before
concluding which.

probes.intent: check whether a managed file has been modified locally before I overwrite it
hash a file's contents so I can tell whether it changed since we wrote it
apply a set of file writes atomically so a crash can't leave a half-installed state
recover an interrupted install from its journal on the next run
undo a partially applied set of file changes when one step fails
make sure the repository's gitignore contains the entries our tooling needs
check if a path is already ignored because one of its parent directories is ignored
walk up from a directory until I find the repository root
read the YAML frontmatter block out of a skill markdown file
record which files an install wrote so the operation can be undone later
flush a directory entry to disk so a rename survives a power loss
reject a path that escapes the directories we are allowed to write to
gather all the telemetry data the dashboard needs to render
roll up author tier observations into per-tier totals
attribute HIGH severity findings to the files they were found in
format a single audit finding for display in the dashboard
resolve a route using whichever framework adapter matches this project
find every call site of rmSync across the codebase
recursively walk an abstract syntax tree visiting every node
detect that a synced file drifted from what the manifest says it should be
parse a MIDI file into note-on and note-off events
compute an optimal seating arrangement for a wedding reception
detect faces in a photograph and draw bounding boxes around them
translate a sentence from English into Japanese
simulate the orbital trajectory of a satellite around Earth
price a European call option using the Black-Scholes formula
convert a chess board position into FEN notation
scale a coffee brewing recipe to a given water weight
generate a QR code image from a URL
match a fingerprint against a biometric database
